objects.name: Token SSRF Indicator
objects.pattern: ([artifact:message LIKE '%Fetching access token for service account%'] AND [artifact:message LIKE '%Loading new entry succeeded%'] AND [artifact:message LIKE '%Fetched token for pod pacman/minimi%'] AND [artifact:message LIKE '%/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token" HTTP/200%'] AND [artifact:message LIKE '%GET /curl?url=http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token HTTP/2.0" 200%']) WITHIN 60 SECONDS
objects.description: Detects attempts to exploit the metadata service vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to service account tokens within a Kubernetes cluster. This pattern identifies a series of suspicious log entries occurring within a short timeframe, indicating an attacker's attempt to fetch access tokens from the metadata service.
